final_caller: So, how do I register for a tin number with ORA?
final_assistant:
Happy to help you register for a T-I-N!

To register for a T-I-N with U-R-A in Uganda: 1. Visit the official U-R-A web portal 2. Navigate to eServices T-I-N Registration 3. Complete the online application form and submit.
Are you registering as an individual (requires your National ID/N-I-N) or an organisation (requires Certificate of Incorporation)?

results.spoken_notice: I'm connecting you to a URA officer, please hold.

en_vat_accuracy.text:
The standard rate of Value Added Tax (V-A-T) is 18 percent, for the 2026 to 2027 financial year. Value Added Tax is charged at 18 percent on taxable supplies of goods and services; V-A-T-registered businesses collect it from customers and remit it to U-R-A. - Statutory Basis: Value Added Tax Act

That comes from the official U-R-A 2026 to 2027 rate table. Would you like more detail?

lg_vat_accuracy.text: Okusinziira ku biwandiiko bya U-R-A, omusolo ogw'ebitundu ebitundu 18 ku buli kikumi gussibwa ku nsimbi zonna ezikung'aanyiziddwa mu kusuza abagenyi mu wooteeri oba ebifo ebisulwamu. Wandiyagadde okwogera n'omukozi ku nsonga eno?
